$comment: Single source of truth for documentation screenshots. Managed by scripts/docs-screenshots.mjs (scaffold | plan | status | insert). Images are served from https://app.spiritdao.org/images/docs/<slug>/<file>. Placement: before-body = directly after the heading line; after-body = at the end of that section's text, before the next heading.

standard.viewport: Phone width, 393 x 852 CSS px (Chrome DevTools > Device toolbar > iPhone 14 Pro) at 2x device pixel ratio, or a real phone. Desktop only where an entry says so (1280 px wide).
standard.format: PNG. Viewport-height capture unless an entry says 'full page'. No browser chrome, no DevTools panel.
standard.account: Use your own account on the Temporal Naturalism pod or a throwaway 'Demo Pod'. Never capture another member's DMs, email, or full wallet address; the app shows truncated addresses, which is fine.
standard.state: Light theme, no Pod Face applied (classic SpiritDAO look) unless the entry is about faces. Dismiss toasts and the guided tour before capturing.
standard.naming: Keep the exact file names below. Save straight into the matching folder under public/images/docs/.
